body: PLAN-51 was done by a Haiku subagent, PLAN-52 and PLAN-53 by a Sonnet subagent, each from the tickets alone. The planner reviewed the diffs and ran the Graph tab in headless Chromium: it renders this plan (25 tickets, 17 relations), a click opens the ticket, the other three tabs still work. Left as it is: lines cross and dashed lines in one column can run through boxes between their ends; a long key plus title can overflow a box; the legend calls the to-do colour Other.
author: claude
